name: Selection Lag Host Diagnostic Probe
description: Task-local diagnostic probe for the user-reported select-and-drag stall on the exact Cubism host: EDT mouse-event dispatch timing (event-gap + heartbeat latency), ThreadMXBean top-stack capture above a threshold, Robot press-drag-release interaction, and structured JSON evidence. Observation-only: never saves, never writes the model, never creates Undo.

permissions.reason: Reads the active model identity and the SDK selection snapshot on the exact host for diagnostic evidence.
